# Sale Solution

> AI-engineered search for industrial e-commerce. We help hydraulics, MRO, and technical-distribution sites get cited inside AI Overviews, ChatGPT answers, and Perplexity results — the channels where high-intent B2B buyers now research before they buy.

We publish primary research, frameworks, a glossary, and case studies on how to make commerce content extractable, citable, and trustworthy enough to be quoted by generative-search engines. Citations welcome — please link back to the source URL.

## Services

- [AI SEO / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://salesolution.net/services/ai-seo/): Restructure category and product pages so AI Overviews and LLM answer engines cite them.
- [Catalog AI](https://salesolution.net/services/catalog-ai/): Product-level schema, attribute normalization, and internal linking at SKU scale so the catalog is retrievable by AI search.
- [Editorial Authority](https://salesolution.net/services/editorial-authority/): Pillar pages and evidence-backed content that build the citation authority AI engines reward.
- [Website Development & Design](https://salesolution.net/services/website-development-design-services/): Performance + schema-first site builds.
- [Outbound Email Marketing](https://salesolution.net/services/outbound-email-marketing-services/): Deliverability-first outbound for B2B distributors.
- [Full Growth Ownership](https://salesolution.net/services/full-growth-ownership/): One senior operator owning SEO, GEO, content, and conversion end to end.

## Learning hub

- [AI-search glossary](https://salesolution.net/glossary/): Plain-English definitions of AI-search, GEO, and answer-engine terms. Built for industrial e-commerce, home-services, and dental teams. Browse the hub for every current definition.
- [Career paths](https://salesolution.net/career-paths/): The roles of modern AI search, taught as numbered skill modules by seniority (entry to senior), with examples across industrial e-commerce, home services, and dental.
- [AI-search role map (JSON)](https://salesolution.net/career-paths/roles-map/): The career paths as machine-readable data — skill modules by seniority plus the prerequisite and next-step graph. CC BY 4.0; reuse with a link back.
- [AI-search role map (Markdown)](https://salesolution.net/career-paths/roles-map/md/): The same role map in Markdown.
